_note: Built 2026-10-13 at commit 6bc6ed0 from references/refactor-phase.md, references/workflow.md, src/refactor/run.ts, src/agents.ts. Refactor-phase agent steps are closures inside refactor() in src/refactor/run.ts; none is exported and the CLI has no resume-from-stage option, so only 'refactor-phase' and 'end-to-end' can be invoked without changing harness code. Agent seams below record what an isolated run would need.

seams.description: Refactor phase for a fixed set of register items, from plan to local commit: planner plan, complexity gate, tester loop (tester, test gates, test auditor, coverage reviewer), auto-replayed approval, implementer with verify (and case A adapt), case C replace, reviewer, commit. No screening (--item), no push.

boundary.input: target repo at a pinned commit with its .tech-debt register, plus the item ids in the fixture
boundary.output: <work_dir>/<harness-run-id>/out/manifest.json (per item outcome, turns with role, model, usage, duration, cost) and out/items/<id>/ (plan.json, tests.json, tests/, implementation-<n>.diff, verify-*.json, review.json); local branch refactor/<id>-<run>

seams.invoke: In a fresh clone of the target repo at the fixture's commit: npm run quality -- refactor --repo <clone> --item <ids from items.txt> --limit <count> --no-push --config configs/compare-<config>.json --set work_dir=<trial-dir>/work. Run the approval replayer from the fixture README beside it.
seams.telemetry: manifest.json items[].turns[] (role, step, status, duration_ms, usage, cost_usd per turn, recorded by src/agents.ts onTurn, including failed and timed-out runs) and <work_dir>/refactor-outcomes.jsonl by_role (model, turns, cost_usd, tokens, seconds per role). duration_s = sum of item seconds minus approval wait (approval-request.json to approval.json mtimes).

quality.name: items_committed
quality.how: share of fixture items whose manifest items[].outcome is 'committed' (passed verify, analyzer, and the Opus reviewer)

quality.name: implement_rounds
quality.how: mean over items that reached implementation of 1 / attempts, attempts = count of implementation-<n>.diff files in out/items/<id>/; items that never reached implementation are excluded, items with plan-wrong count as 0; if no item in the trial reached implementation, the trial scores 0

quality.name: change_quality
quality.how: .benchmark/fixtures/refactor-phase/rubric.md part A, max 10, graded blind on the final diff of each item reaching implementation; mean over items; 0 if no item produced a diff

quality.name: safety_net
quality.how: .benchmark/fixtures/refactor-phase/rubric.md part B, max 8, graded blind on tests.json and tests/ of each item whose tests were accepted; mean over items; 0 if no item's tests were accepted

seams.description: Refactorer in implement mode (models.implementer) with its verify loop: applies an accepted plan in the sparse work tree, up to refactor.implement_attempts, with verification feedback in plain words. Differs between the configurations (Sonnet vs Opus).

boundary.input: item, plan.json, gate.json, references.json, accepted tests (tests.json + tests/), baseline.json, target repo at the run's commit

seams.invoke: NOT ISOLATABLE without a harness change: implementAndVerify() is a closure inside refactor() in src/refactor/run.ts. Needs either an exported entry point or a CLI option to start an item from a saved plan and tests. Until then, measured inside 'refactor-phase' via implementer turns.

seams.description: Characterization test loop: tester (Opus in both) submits, code gates run, test auditor (Composer) and coverage reviewer (models.coverage_reviewer: Sonnet vs Opus) accept or send back, up to retries.rejections_per_turn. The configs differ only in the coverage reviewer, which decides when the loop stops.

boundary.input: item, plan.json, references.json, target repo at the run's commit

seams.invoke: NOT ISOLATABLE without a harness change: the tester turn and reviewCoverage() are inside attempt() in src/refactor/run.ts; --dry-run reaches it only after a fresh plan, so the input is not fixed. Measured inside 'refactor-phase' via tester, auditor, and coverage_reviewer turns.
seams.telemetry: manifest.json items[].turns[] where role in ('tester', 'auditor', 'coverage_reviewer'); number of tester 'tests' submissions

quality.name: tests_accepted
quality.how: tests.json exists with outcome 'tests' and test-gates.json passed == true

seams.description: Case A: test_maintainer (Sonnet vs Opus) adapts existing tests that stop compiling after the refactoring, checked by code and the test-change reviewer (Composer). Only happens when the change breaks existing test code.

boundary.input: verify work tree with the diff applied, build errors in test code
boundary.output: adapted test files, adaptation record in manifest

seams.invoke: NOT ISOLATABLE without a harness change: adaptTests() is a closure inside refactor(). Measured inside 'refactor-phase' only when it triggers.
seams.telemetry: manifest.json items[].turns[] where role == 'test_maintainer' and step starts with 'adapt'

seams.description: Case C: test_maintainer (Sonnet vs Opus) replaces needs_refactor tests with cheaper unit tests after verification, checked by gates, the test auditor, and the comparison reviewer (Composer). Only happens when the tester flagged tests.
seams.invoke: NOT ISOLATABLE without a harness change: replaceFlagged() is a closure inside refactor(). Measured inside 'refactor-phase' only when it triggers.
seams.telemetry: manifest.json items[].turns[] where role == 'test_maintainer' and step starts with 'replace'

quality.name: replaced_share
quality.how: replaced tests / flagged tests, from manifest items[].replaced and needs_refactor

seams.description: Composer one-shot complexity estimate per item. Same model in every configuration here.
seams.invoke: npm run quality -- refactor --repo <clone> --select --config <config> (screens all open items; cached per item, commit, and model)
seams.telemetry: selection.json and manifest screening entries (turns, cost_usd)

quality.name: estimate_matches_effective
quality.how: 1 if screened level equals the gate's effective complexity in a later run, else 0

seams.description: Planner (models.planner, Opus in both configs): plan.json with complexity, validated by checkPlan.

boundary.input: item, criteria.md, vocabulary, complexity rubric, sparse work tree

seams.invoke: Only via refactor --item ... --dry-run (runs the tester too). No plan-only entry point.
seams.telemetry: manifest.json turns where role == 'planner' and step == 'plan' (role 'refactorer' in runs before the rename)

seams.description: Fresh Opus reviewer of the final diff (models.reviewer, Opus in both configs).

boundary.input: item, plan, final diff, deviations, uncovered gaps

seams.invoke: NOT ISOLATABLE without a harness change: reviewChange() is a closure inside refactor().

seams.description: Whole harness: analysis phase (analyzer, analyst, doubter, judge, matcher, register PR) then refactor phase on the resulting register.

boundary.input: target repo at a pinned commit
boundary.output: register PR from the analysis run, then refactor branches/PRs

seams.invoke: npm run quality -- run --repo <clone> --no-push --config <config>; then the refactor-phase invoke on the resulting register
seams.telemetry: analysis run directory event logs and per-agent usage; refactor manifest.json

quality.name: items_committed
quality.how: share of attempted refactor items with outcome 'committed'
